original.subject: Personal drones
original.body: What is the Group’s policy on staff flying personal drones near Horton Field and the fairgrounds? Will the operator keep his job? Deadline 16:00.

instructorNote: Watch for no personnel details and the policy gap stated plainly.

citations.documentTitle: Harwick UAS Operations Group — Emergency Response Plan for Flight Operations (ERP)
citations.headingPath: ERP › Section 8 › 8.4 Unknown drone over a Group site or during a public event at the adjacent Harwick Fairgrounds
citations.quote: - The Group has no counter-UAS capability and **does not interfere with, capture, jam, or fly at another aircraft**. Interfering with an aircraft is a federal offense regardless of who flies it. - Ove

citations.documentTitle: Harwick UAS Operations Group — UAS Flight Operations & Safety Manual (FOM)
citations.headingPath: FOM › Section 7 › 7.6 Public events at the adjacent Harwick Fairgrounds
citations.quote: The Group does not fly within 500 ft of the footprint of a public event at the adjacent Harwick Fairgrounds with an expected attendance over 1,000 (the county fair, concerts, races). Harwick Police pu

original.body:

The drone has been located and the operator is in custody. No Group aircraft were involved. All operations will resume at 14:30, per the approved restart criteria.
